bridge_chains.name: renewal_theory_to_simd_decode
bridge_chains.description: Renewal theory predicts sync distance, which determines how far apart SIMD decode cursors must be to guarantee convergence, directly parameterizing the multi-cursor decode strategy.

bridge_chains.name: algebra_to_gpu_decompression
bridge_chains.description: WFST composition in speech recognition uses the same monoid structure that enables parallel prefix scan of FSM transitions, which is the theoretical foundation for GPU-parallel bit-swizzled DEFLATE decode.

bridge_chains.name: cpu_architecture_to_compression
bridge_chains.description: CPU branch prediction techniques inspire speculative block boundary prediction, which when combined with cache-prefetch patterns from OS design, produces practical parallel decompression systems like rapidgzip.

bridge_chains.name: information_theory_to_parallel_algorithms
bridge_chains.description: Information bottleneck analysis prunes the state space of enumerated FSM evaluation, reducing the work constant in parallel prefix scan, making Ladner-Fischer construction practical for large Huffman alphabets.

bridge_chains.name: graph_theory_to_hardware
bridge_chains.description: Modeling LZ77 as a dependency graph enables wavefront parallelism, which pairs with bit-swizzled Huffman decode to create a two-phase parallel decompression pipeline implementable in SIMD.
